names-not-a-map.title: Names, not a map
names-not-a-map.keywords: this work has names, four of them, one line each, labels, one small habit
names-not-a-map.script: This work has names now. There are four of them, and I will give you one line each. They are not a map of the party, just labels for things you already did. Then we will turn them into one small habit you can start with your next real task.
